_about: Lowy Institute Poll, Better party by foreign policy issue. Every chart share is generated from the official interactive chart's verbatim Svelte default.values grid, for all four years and every available demographic split, issue and response. The report PDFs verify available stems, fieldwork, overall achieved samples and modes; they do not replace chart values.
_provenance: The official full-page chart and /charts/embed/ form are parsed independently and must agree. Values come only from their Svelte hydration object, never the displayed SVG, a guessed CSV endpoint or an LLM-supplied figure. The split-major source grid is transposed to year-major without altering cells. Where a chart and report table differ, the chart is retained rather than silently reconciled: in 2013 Total / Managing Australia’s relations with Asia / Don’t know / no view, the chart value is 8 while the 2013 report's Table 1 prints 9.

semantics.unit: Percent of respondents in the chart cell; source-rounded shares, retained exactly as supplied.
semantics.sourceShape: The cached default.values plane is values[splitIndex][yearIndex][categoryIndex][responseIndex]. Only its two outer axes are transposed on output.
semantics.emptyCategory: An empty array [] means no chart row exists for that year × split × issue. It never means zero.
semantics.blankResponse: An empty string "" is blank in an otherwise populated row, not zero. The response vocabulary is a superset across waves and must not be read as proof that every option was offered in every wave. The Svelte object's separate top-level values copy incorrectly coerces this blank to zero and is deliberately not used.
semantics.null: A source null, if present, remains null and denotes unavailable/missing source data, never zero.
semantics.zero: Numeric zero is an actual chart value and is not converted to blank or null.
semantics.splitLabels: The ordered split labels are verbatim and positional. Duplicate labels (for example SA and ACT in different demographic sections) are retained; no unique ids or deduplicated split names are invented.
